climate: Pinot Noir sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.
Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A "super-AVA" in southwest Oregon that joins the Rogue Valley and Umpqua Valley so the two regions can market together. Pinot Noir is the most planted grape, followed by Pinot Gris, Syrah and Chardonnay.
